newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania leu closes static vs dlr in sleepy market.
newsitem.headline: Romania leu closes static vs dlr in sleepy market.

text.p: Romania's leu currency closed at 3,305/15 to the dollar on Friday after inching down from 3,300/10 on Thursday on a fairly inactive interbank market.
Operators said intrabank trading continued to focus on other currencies whose cross rates deliver lower leu-dollar rates, in line with to retail prices of around 3,600.
The leu saw a modest 10-unit slide against the dollar this week on a foreign exchange market reflecting hard currency shortages.

It appeared unimpressed by a recent forecast by Alexandru Ghiba, First Vice-President of Bancorex, who said the leu's true value was closer to 5,500 to 6,000 and who predicted a fall to possibly 10,000-12,000 within a year.
The government and central bank dismissed the notion.
Most traders agreed the leu was too firm but said its real rate could be no lower than 4,500.
Latest central bank data showed a zero interbank volume on Thursday, when overall trading was $13.2 million.
Short-term rates hovered near 44 percent on a money market overfiled with leu funds. -- Mirela Eremia, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
